body: Founder: 'then continue' (following the plan published in 'The Plan, As Far As It Goes' -- finish GTA7's scoped work before starting anything new). Rogue Swarms: triggers automatically at Watcher alertness 90 (above Enforcement's 65), 3 real containment objectives around the FO, any faction's damage counts toward participation, 3-minute timer. Success rewards all participants with faction rep regardless of faction (real cross-faction cooperation per NORTHSTAR.md's own VS4 spec). Failure scars the FO: reverts to unclaimed, halved Flow generation persists through the next claim (FieldOfficeManager.scar()/claimScarred()). Custody Lock: dying to a named Enforcement mob sends the player to a real jail (GameMode.SPECTATOR, 2-minute real restriction, re-applied on rejoin if still serving), /gta7jail (op-only) sets the location. Deliberately left the 10-man/Annex/1-man housing-tier split unimplemented since TRAPX's own source doctrine lists it as undecided -- didn't invent an answer to a question the spec itself hasn't settled. Built, deployed, confirmed enabling cleanly in server.log with zero exceptions (VS0/VS1/VS2/VS3/VS4 all live). Real gameplay (containment success/failure, custody flow) not yet exercised by a real connected client. First GTA7 commits under the new Traditional-Chinese-commit-description convention.
title: VS4 -- Rogue Swarms + Custody Lock, all 5 milestones live
